entries.subject: Select exact operative Building Regulations / Approved Document source editions and transition basis for the case
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Exact source/edition/effective/transition identity is required before technical family results can be relied upon.
entries.claimBoundary: Source selection establishes which authority applies; it does not discharge substantive technical requirements.

entries.subject: Structural safety
accelerationTriggers: known structural/load-path condition plausibly capable of defeating the project at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Part A / applicable Approved Document and competent structural evidence at the stage due.
entries.claimBoundary: 09B represents selected A-family obligations; family presence is not structural adequacy or complete Part A compliance.

entries.subject: Fire safety
accelerationTriggers: known access/escape/fire-strategy condition plausibly capable of defeating the project at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part B source/edition and competent fire/building-control evidence.
entries.claimBoundary: Family is covered but no general Part B evaluator is implemented.

entries.subject: Site preparation, contaminants and resistance to moisture
accelerationTriggers: known contamination/groundwater/moisture/ground condition plausibly capable of defeating the project at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part C source/edition plus site/ground/moisture evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: 09B represents selected C-family obligations; detailed site investigation/moisture design remains external.

entries.subject: Cavity insulation / toxic-substance safeguards where applicable
accelerationTriggers: candidate explicitly relies on a Part D-triggering insulation/material condition at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicability fact plus applicable Part D authority where triggered.
entries.claimBoundary: Missing applicability facts remain unresolved; conditional does not mean not applicable.

entries.subject: Resistance to the passage of sound
accelerationTriggers: known noise/adjacency/build-up constraint makes acoustic adequacy decision-critical at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part E source/edition and acoustic evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: No native whole-Part-E method is implied by registry coverage.

entries.subject: Ventilation
accelerationTriggers: known ventilation/air-quality/system-geometry constraint makes the family decision-critical at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part F source/edition and competent ventilation design/commissioning evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: Reference House MVHR selection is architectural/system geography, not Part F discharge.

entries.subject: Sanitation, hot-water safety and water efficiency
accelerationTriggers: known water/sanitation/system constraint makes the family decision-critical at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part G source/edition and technical design evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: Registry coverage does not prove water efficiency, hot-water safety or sanitary provision.

entries.subject: Foul water, wastewater, rainwater drainage and waste disposal
accelerationTriggers: known sewer/outfall/infiltration/drainage condition plausibly capable of defeating the project at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part H source/edition plus drainage/network/ground evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: 09C represents selected H1-H5 obligations; it does not select discharge strategy or prove hydraulic/network adequacy.

entries.subject: Combustion appliances and fuel storage systems where present
accelerationTriggers: candidate introduces a combustion appliance/fuel-storage system
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Explicit system applicability plus applicable Part J authority where triggered.
entries.claimBoundary: Current Reference House heat-pump baseline does not universalise Part J as not applicable to every future candidate.

entries.subject: Protection from falling, collision and impact
accelerationTriggers: known stair/guarding/level-change geometry creates a decision-critical conflict at screening
selectedMethodRefs: RH-C5 private-stair geometry selected numeric method
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part K source/edition; RH-C5 covers only its declared selected stair numeric method.
entries.claimBoundary: RH-C5 is not a generic Part K compliance result and does not establish family completeness.

entries.subject: Conservation of fuel and power
accelerationTriggers: known form/orientation/envelope/system condition makes energy compliance plausibility decision-critical at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part L source/edition and competent energy/calculation evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: Reference House environmental strategy is not Part L compliance.

entries.subject: Access to and use of buildings
accelerationTriggers: known approach/threshold/internal access condition makes access category feasibility decision-critical at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part M source/edition and declared dwelling access category / evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: London planning M4 category assignment, where represented, remains separate from technical Part M discharge.

entries.subject: Overheating mitigation
accelerationTriggers: known orientation/glazing/noise/security/site condition makes overheating feasibility decision-critical at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part O source/edition and competent overheating assessment when due.
entries.claimBoundary: Passive-first architectural intent is not Part O discharge.

entries.subject: Electrical safety in dwellings
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part P authority and competent electrical design/certification when due.
entries.claimBoundary: Architectural electrical geography is not Part P certification.

entries.subject: Security of dwellings
accelerationTriggers: known opening/access condition makes secure-door/window compliance feasibility decision-critical at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part Q authority and product/detail evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: Window/door architectural conformance is separate from Part Q security evidence.

entries.subject: Physical infrastructure / connection for electronic communications in new dwellings
accelerationTriggers: known network/connection constraint makes provision feasibility decision-critical at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Applicable Part R authority and network/provider evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: Street-context telecom availability is not evidence of compliant connection/infrastructure.

entries.subject: Infrastructure for charging electric vehicles where applicable
accelerationTriggers: parking/project conditions bring Part S provision into scope and site/electrical capacity becomes decision-critical
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Explicit applicability plus applicable Part S authority and electrical/provider evidence where due.
entries.claimBoundary: Conditional family coverage does not establish parking provision or electrical capacity.

entries.subject: Materials and workmanship
accelerationTriggers: known material/system selection creates a decision-critical fitness/workmanship issue at screening
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Current Regulation 7 authority and appropriate material/workmanship evidence when due.
entries.claimBoundary: 09B represents a bounded materials/workmanship slice, not construction-quality proof.

entries.subject: Applicable building-control approval/notice/process route
accelerationTriggers: a screening decision depends on a specific statutory process/approval route or transition status
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Current Building Regulations / building-control process authority for the project class and date.
entries.claimBoundary: Compiler can register the process family but cannot grant approval or issue statutory notices/certificates.

entries.subject: Building-regulations dutyholder / competence obligations
accelerationTriggers: the work has progressed from hypothetical screening into regulated design/appointment activity where current duties attach
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Current dutyholder/competence authority and project appointment/process evidence.
entries.claimBoundary: Registry coverage does not appoint competent parties or certify competence.

entries.subject: Completion-stage certification, information, inspection and handover duties
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Current completion/certification/process authority at the later assurance profile where due.
entries.claimBoundary: Explicitly future-due at SCREENING; presence in the family universe is not an early completion obligation.

entries.subject: Higher-risk building gateway/regime applicability
accelerationTriggers: project class changes such that higher-risk-building definitions may be engaged
entries.sourceIdentityRequirement: Controlled project class remains the ordinary low-rise detached Reference House; any class change invalidates this exclusion.
entries.claimBoundary: Exclusion is project-class-specific and must not be generalised to other buildings.
